title: One Ending, Two Sentences
label: ch:ml-aan
canDo: I can say what I am going somewhere in order to do, and say what I am able to do.

payoff.summary: From cold: the -uka to -aan swap, the purpose sentence it builds in front of another verb, and the ability sentence it builds in front of kazhiyum — with the person in the dative, the way knowing already works.
payoff.note: The chapter introduces exactly these three atoms and the payoff assesses all three. Only one new word is added: every verb it uses comes from the reading and going chapters.
